title: Block sender, clean up what is there, one Cmd-Z takes it all back
steps: Launch with -UseFakeGmail (fake mail only), open the Inbox and put the cursor on a conversation from a sender with two or more conversations
Press Option-Command-B (or Cmd-K, Block sender); when the toast offers cleanup, press Archive all
Press Cmd-Z once, then Shift-Cmd-Z once
expected: Option-Command-B shows 'Blocked <address>' with Undo, then 'Clean up N conversations from them?' with Archive all and Move to Trash (ignoring it keeps them). Archive all takes the sender's inbox conversations out in one batch. One Cmd-Z brings them all back and removes the rule; Shift-Cmd-Z blocks and archives again. Settings > Blocked lists the address while it is blocked.
